title: End-Semester Theory & Practical Examination Timetable Released
description: The final timetable for Odd Semester 2026 regular and arrear examinations has been published. Hall tickets will be downloadable via the student portal from next Monday. Students must verify subject codes and report discrepancies to the Exam Cell.

title: Google & Microsoft Cloud Campus Recruitment Drive 2026
description: On-campus recruitment drive for 2026 graduating batch (CSE, IT, ECE). Job roles include Software Development Engineer (SDE) and Cloud Solutions Architect. Minimum CGPA required: 7.8 with no active backlogs. CTC: 18 - 28 LPA.

title: 🚨 Emergency Campus Power Grid Overhaul & Maintenance
description: Essential high-voltage transformer maintenance scheduled for Saturday. Central server rooms, main library, and academic Blocks A, B, and C will have power shutdown from 08:00 AM to 04:00 PM. All offline laboratories will remain closed.

title: National Hackathon 2026: AI for Smart Cities (48-Hour Sprint)
description: Department of CSE invites student teams (3-4 members) to participate in the National Smart Cities Hackathon with cash prizes worth 2.5 Lakhs INR. Mentorship provided by industry leaders. Registration deadline is November 10th.

title: Mandatory 75% Attendance Requirement for Semester End Eligibility
description: As per Academic Regulations, students must maintain a minimum of 75% aggregate attendance in each registered theory and laboratory course to be permitted for semester examinations. Students in the 65%-74% band must submit medical condonation forms immediately.

title: Post-Matric & Merit-Cum-Means Scholarship Portal Window Extended
description: Government and institutional scholarship applications portal has been extended till November 25, 2026. Eligible SC/ST, OBC, and economically weaker section students should upload verified income and caste certificates at the Dean Office counter.

title: Hands-on Workshop: Generative AI and Edge Computing on Raspberry Pi 5
description: Two-day technical workshop organized by ECE and CSE departments exploring tinyML, edge inference, and Gemini API integration. Registration fee of Rs. 300 includes hardware kit access and certificate.

title: Inter-Collegiate Sports Tournament Selections (Cricket, Football, Badminton)
description: Physical Education Department announces university trials for Men and Women athletic squads. Interested sports candidates should report in sports attire to the University Stadium with student ID card.

title: Diwali & Mid-Term Festival Break Announcement
description: The institution will observe holiday for Diwali from November 01 to November 04, 2026. Academic sessions, library services, and administrative offices will resume normal operation on Wednesday, November 05.

title: Smart Campus Notice Board Voice Recognition Feedback & Beta Testing
description: IT & R&D division has deployed the AI Voice Assistant on the central campus kiosks. Students are encouraged to test voice queries (e.g., 'What is today's schedule?', 'Show exam alerts') and submit feedback through the mobile app.
